title: WatchScreen response timeouts
root_cause: Vendor capacity issue during sanctions list update
impact: Service degraded for 50 minutes, no regulatory impact.

title: MQ channel to Group Ledger stopped
root_cause: Channel retry limit reached after network maintenance
impact: Service degraded for 111 minutes, no regulatory impact.

title: CICS region short-on-storage
root_cause: Storage leak in a long-running transaction
impact: Service degraded for 42 minutes, no regulatory impact.

title: Sentinel scoring failures after FRAUDNET rename
root_cause: CLRFR020 still called fraudnet.corvane.internal, its TLS certificate had been reissued only for sentinel.corvane.internal on 2025-03-01.
impact: 1,214 claims left unscored for 6 h 40 min, back-scored by the nightly batch at 00:15 on 2025-03-04.

title: GL reserve journals rejected after CLX-IF-042 layout change
systems: CLARA / MQ Backbone / Group Ledger / NISA Reporting Hub
root_cause: RSVMOVE field RM-AMOUNT widened from S9(9)V99 to S9(11)V99 COMP-3 under CHUB-138 without a consumer impact assessment, the GL adapter (CLX-IF-043) rejected every record.
impact: Reserve journals missing for 2025-04-25 to 2025-04-29, Q1 2025 NISA-TP2 return submitted 2025-05-07 instead of 2025-05-05 (2-day extension).

title: PALM snapshot feed truncated
root_cause: Disk full on the transfer server
impact: Service degraded for 245 minutes, no regulatory impact.

title: SIU Case Manager queue permissions lost after re-org
systems: SIU Case Manager / Corvane Identity Service
root_cause: Role mapping in CIS still pointed SIU queues at the Claims department group after SIU moved to Risk & Compliance.
impact: 42 new referrals not visible to investigators for 5.5 hours.

title: document-svc failed to store documents after DOCSTOR renamed to Evidence Vault
root_cause: document-svc configuration still used the DOCSTOR base URL retired at the rename.
impact: Uploads queued for 3 h 10 min on MVP go-live day, no data loss.

title: CDW nightly load overran
root_cause: Statistics not refreshed after large backfill
impact: Service degraded for 252 minutes, no regulatory impact.

title: Harbour CRM telephony integration outage
root_cause: Vendor-side release defect
impact: Service degraded for 254 minutes, no regulatory impact.

title: DB2 lock escalation on CLR.T_CLAIM
root_cause: Missing commit frequency in a batch program
impact: Service degraded for 133 minutes, no regulatory impact.

title: Year-end revaluation job CLRYGL90 abended
root_cause: Malformed SEK year-end rate (comma decimal separator) caused S0C7 in CLRGL090.
impact: Rerun completed 06:40, no reporting impact.

title: Notify letter batch failed validation
root_cause: Template field length exceeded
impact: Service degraded for 278 minutes, no regulatory impact.

title: CLX-IF-049 bridge consumer lag during parallel run
root_cause: reserve-engine consumer group had 3 consumers for 12 partitions after a rolling restart, lag reached 6 hours.
impact: Parallel-run reconciliation for 2026-03-08 delayed to the afternoon.

title: Batch fraud sweep used pre-2026 referral threshold
root_cause: CLRFR040 hard-codes WS-REFER-THRESHOLD VALUE 070 instead of reading CLR.T_PARAM, online path CLRFR030 was correct.
impact: 37 claims scored 65–69 between 2026-04-01 and 2026-05-12 were not referred by the batch path, referred manually on 2026-05-13.

title: ReCede cession file rejected
root_cause: Unknown treaty code after renewal
impact: Service degraded for 37 minutes, no regulatory impact.

title: Assessor Portal SFTP key expired
root_cause: Partner SFTP key not rotated before expiry
impact: Service degraded for 223 minutes, no regulatory impact.

title: reserve-engine Tier-3 review cadence mismatch
root_cause: CLARA picked up RSV_T3_REVIEW_DAYS = 14 on 2026-07-01 but reserve-engine config tier3-review-days was still 21.
impact: 412 Tier-3 claims mismatched in the parallel-run reconciliation.

title: Batch Scheduler calendar error on bank holiday
root_cause: Calendar not updated for the Nordic holiday
impact: Service degraded for 194 minutes, no regulatory impact.

title: CIS token signing key rollover issue
root_cause: Clients cached the old JWKS
impact: Service degraded for 275 minutes, no regulatory impact.

title: Kafka broker disk pressure on esp-prd
root_cause: Retention misconfigured on a high-volume topic
impact: Service degraded for 152 minutes, no regulatory impact.

title: Duplicate payment instructions on Wave 1 cut-over
root_cause: payment-orchestrator retried on a CPG timeout without an idempotency key.
impact: 18 claims paid twice, total £41,236.50, all recalled by 2026-09-18.

title: Evidence Intake Gateway photo backlog
root_cause: Autoscaling limit reached after storm event
impact: Service degraded for 250 minutes, no regulatory impact.

title: Tier-3 referral threshold not applied in Claims Hub until config reload
root_cause: triage-svc cached the referral thresholds and did not reload the tier3 value deployed under CHUB-388.
impact: 9 Tier-3 claims scored 60–64 between 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-05 not referred, referred manually.

title: Payment confirmation file arrived late from CPG
root_cause: Bank-side processing delay
impact: Service degraded for 286 minutes, no regulatory impact.
